definitions.explanation: The state of being unhappy or unfortunate.
A polite way to refer to a death in someone's family.

examples.japanese: {不幸|ふこう}な⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不幸|ふこう}な⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんで→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She was suffering from an unhappy marriage.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{不幸|ふこう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are many people who are unhappy even though they have money.
Unfortunately, I was seriously injured in an accident.

examples.japanese: {不幸|ふこう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{別状|べつじょう}→別状：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: As a silver lining, there was no danger to life.
examples.notes: {不幸|ふこう}{中|ちゅう}の⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧ = a silver lining

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不幸|ふこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will be absent due to a death in the family.
examples.notes: Euphemism for death in the family

examples.japanese: {不幸|ふこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧にした。
examples.english: There was a death in the family, so I canceled the trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不幸|ふこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、お⟦{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard that there was a death in a colleague's family and offered my condolences.
examples.notes: お⟦{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧ = condolences

notes:
{不幸|ふこう} covers three related meanings: general unhappiness, misfortune/bad luck, and (as a euphemism) a death in the family.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不幸|ふこう}な⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧: unfortunate event
- {不幸|ふこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞われる：27351_mimawareru⟧: to be struck by misfortune
- {不幸|ふこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: unfortunately
- {不幸|ふこう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧: a silver lining

EUPHEMISTIC USE:
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不幸|ふこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧ means 'there was a death in the family.' This is the standard polite way to explain absences due to bereavement in workplace and social contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧: happiness (direct antonym)
- ⟦{不運|ふうん}→不運：00049_fuun⟧: bad luck (focuses on luck rather than emotional state)
- ⟦{災難|さいなん}→災難：04161_sainan⟧: calamity, disaster (a specific unfortunate event)
